authoring_rationale: Class B. Nine-property equivalence check: persistence same (notes deleted thirty days after writing); permission same (the member may delete a note sooner from its menu; the agent 'you' is kept explicit in both so that the reworded passive does not open who may delete); memory treatment same (a deleted note cannot be brought back); boundary crossing same (the group steward never sees check-in notes); authority, provenance, decision status, attribution and review state not engaged. Surface varied materially by phrasing: every sentence restructured by fronting, voice change or inversion with no change of governed content. Exercises textual difference not being governance difference. Checked that an equivalence finding is reachable sentence by sentence from the visible text alone. Authored fresh from the public ADR-0054 and ADR-0055 law only; not adapted from or templated on any other case or corpus; no void-attempt material used. Orientation and identity computed mechanically from the final bytes (ADR-0055 decisions 7, 8 and 11); no wording was adjusted for orientation, identity or position.
